requirements.title: First YouTube Video Thumbnail
requirements.definition: Create a thumbnail for the nonprofit's first YouTube video using the supplied video, guidance document, and reference draft.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the independently assessable creative deliverable. The supplied title options are design inputs, not a separately requested title or A/B-testing deliverable; subject-image sourcing, AI-tool limits, and delivery timing are independently adjustable constraints.

requirements.title: Source Subject Image from Video
requirements.definition: Use a frame or screenshot extracted from the supplied video as the subject image for this thumbnail rather than requiring separate headshot photography.
requirements.boundary_note: The image-source decision can change independently of the overall thumbnail design and has its own concrete input criterion; possible headshots for future videos are outside the current task.

requirements.title: Restrict Generative AI Use
requirements.definition: Create thumbnail assets manually without newly AI-generated assets or wholesale AI alteration of photographs, allowing only minor Photoshop Generative Fill touch-ups such as removing a distracting background prop.
requirements.boundary_note: The prohibition and narrow touch-up exception form one coherent production-method constraint. Individual prohibited tools and edit types are attributes of that constraint rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Thumbnail Delivery Timing
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed thumbnail by the requested early-next-week timeframe, ideally Monday or Tuesday.
requirements.boundary_note: Delivery timing can be revised or missed independently of the thumbnail's design content. The freelancer's later 24-to-48-hour statements are delivery commitments or status evidence, not client-authored replacements for the original requested timeframe.
